rows.grounds: locative plural of compound sarva+varṇa, indicating all social classes
gerundive expressing obligation, agreeing with the named feminine subjects
indeclinable indicating continuation of the preceding instruction

items.question: Must the deities Kālikā and Śyāmalā be bestowed across all social classes?
premises: The instruction applies to all social classes.
Kālikā is prescribed as to be given.
Śyāmalā is likewise prescribed as to be given.
items.inference: Kālikā and Śyāmalā are to be given in all social classes.
items.plain_english: Kālikā and Śyāmalā are likewise to be given in all classes.
